Bleach & Blood

A downloadable game for Windows, macOS, and Linux

Download NowName your own price
THIS IS A FREE DEMO

Bleach & Blood is a retro PS1-inspired slasher horror game about surviving the night shift at a small-town laundromat while a killer stalks the streets outside.

You play as Evelyn Miller, who moved to a quiet town hoping to escape her past.


WISHLIST ON STEAM

The night shift is only the beginning. Experience Evelyn's complete story when Bleach & Blood launches in 2027.

→ WISHLIST BLEACH & BLOOD ON STEAM

IF YOU LIKED THIS GAME

Check out this free demo of our partner's upcoming Steam game

→ PLAY THE ARCADE DEMO

Now she works the night shift at a local laundromat, serving strange customers as increasingly unsettling events begin to unfold.

Features

  • Retro PS1-inspired visuals
  • Night-shift laundromat gameplay
  • Interactive environments
  • Story-driven slasher horror
  • Computer minigames

About the Demo

Play the free 25–30 minute opening chapter of Bleach & Blood, including Evelyn’s first night shift. The demo is a work in progress and may not fully represent the final game.

Estimated playtime: 25-30 minutes

Aside from these problems? Game seems like it'll be something amazing! Made a video on it.
